messages:
maya: Quick check — I'm pushing a small PR that centralizes the compact JSON examples for tool-calling. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1678

liam: saw it, will skim. main concern was the example using optional fields, right?

maya: yep. Need to make the guardrail example clearer for nullable arrays and also add an explicit parse-fallback snippet.

sasha: could we add a tiny SDK example too? JS and Py for the parse fallback? users keep asking for that.

maya: good call. planning to add a `parseWithFallback` snippet. sketch:
```
const out = await client.invoke({model: 'rwdl-embed', input});
const parsed = parseWithFallback(out, schema, {fallback: {action: 'ask_human'}})
```

liam: minor nit — use `rwdl-chat` not `rwdl-embed` for the tool-calling example. Also add a note about streaming not preserving envelope shapes.

ev an: I can take the JS snippet and port to Py. PR comments incoming.

ci-bot: Build passed for docs PR #1678 :white_check_mark:

sasha: For the compact schema example, let's show both the strict JSON Schema and a lightweight pseudo-schema for quick copy-paste.

maya: done. also added a short section: "When to prefer guardrails vs post-parse validation" — can someone sanity-check wording?

liam: pushed a tiny wording tweak. also fixed a broken link in the examples TOC (was pointing to old path).

maya: thanks. leaving one TODO: add test harness snippet showing how to fuzz the parser with edgecases (nulls, extra keys, union arrays).

ev an: I'll add a Cypress + Node unit that runs a few inputs through `validateAndNormalize`.

sasha: LGTM aside from one inline comment about using `status: 'retry'` vs `status: 'defer'` in the fallback.

maya: ok switching to `defer`. Thanks all :thumbsup:

liam: when this lands, can we tag a release note and update the SDK snippets package? small CHANGES.md entry.

maya: yes — adding an entry. ETA EOD PST for merge.

ev an: great, i'll watch for the merge and grab the Py snippet for the SDK repo.

ci-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1678 :sparkles:

maya: nice! will follow up with a short blurb for the release notes and a docs site patch request.
